comparison_scope: Same retained private keys and encrypted input as numerical controls. New evaluation keys generated once per changed profile and then reused. Historical low-noise public material is not upgraded. Observed evaluation times exclude loading/cache preparation; they are not controlled paper comparisons.
limitations: Exact error PMF is truncated continuous normal, not the estimator's discrete Gaussian. Noise audit verifies sampled residuals and scale, not distributional security.
Bounded grids do not establish global minima over masks, layouts, weights, beta, dimensions or zeta.

Optimistic rotation-union probabilities and largest-rotation dictionary sizes do not demonstrate feasible attacks; decoder correlations, dictionary construction and heterogeneous residual structure remain assumptions.
Uniform sparse proxy fixes16 positive/15 negative coefficients and omits public block constraints.

This profile does not repair low-noise evaluation keys already disclosed for the same private secret. Diagnostic fixtures reuse existing secrets; deployment must exclude historical weak public key material and use a fresh secret if that material was exposed.
One retained input fixture covers8192 real slots for each function. These are numerical observations, not a whole-run failure-probability proof.
Observed functional times exclude saved-key/cache setup and are not matched paper benchmarks.
